independent_review_method: Direct UTF8 source reads, in-memory SHA256 and exact inverse unified-diff reconstruction. No reviewed Python module was imported or executed.
verified_findings: Every candidate and diff matches the composition proof; reversing each whole-file diff reconstructs its exact declared installed baseline.
External failure_proof and result_event remain byte-identical.
record_failure checks original _owned run/token/task fence, exact submitted Developer row and packet digest, and invocation/run policy inside the audit transaction; it does not release ownership.
Only typed pure parse/schema rejection enters the original-provider/packet/owner/fence-bound HOLD. Failure-proof helper I/O and authority errors retain their error/uncertain path.
AutomationRun success recording follows strict result, gateway, QA predecessor, delivery manifest and current publication gates, plus actual artifact publication/readback.
A genuine proof-bound Developer fail remains unchanged in its saved result and emits run.blocked, acceptance_passed false and qa_verdict None.

The same future Developer guidance is consumed by actual dispatch and context; continue, blocked and ready_for_review guidance preserves genuine failed-test evidence without inviting fail as a QA verdict.

terminal_evidence.method: Independently read the original retained job records through read_shell_background; both were terminal, untruncated and exit0.

limitations: Source acceptance is not deployed or live verified.
Root must perform current installed/dependency/process and authenticated idle/admission/cutover checks; historical snapshots do not substitute.
No completion, recovery, successor dispatch, ownership release or provider replay was performed by this review.
